summary: sixbails 1.1.1: weak static signal on generics.js utility file
details: A a static rule flagged co-occurrence of keywords ('ping', 'GET', 'id') in lib/Utils/generics.js at line 403 of the package sixbails. The rule matches on keyword proximity within a single utility file, which is a shape shared by many benign helpers (HTTP utility wrappers, connection/keepalive probes, ID/query builders). No traced evidence of a specific installer-side data read, no traced non-first-party exfiltration destination, no lifecycle hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall) tied to network activity, and no credential-store or environment scraping is corroborated. Traced-code analysis for this version did not produce parsable findings, so the pattern is uncorroborated.
